mapper.select: SELECT * FROM levels WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY order_index ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO levels (id, name, description, order_index, unlock_requirement, image_url, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{name}, #{description}, #{orderIndex}, #{unlockRequirement}, #{imageUrl}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
